name: Walton County, GA
findings: Walton County has 324 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Walton County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Walton County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 26 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
